text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I witnessed your heart-stopping race the other day!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You achieved a glorious victory over your rival! A splendid performance! I hope you will continue to ride this momentum!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa offers glowing praise after <chrname> defeats a powerful opponent! I'm even more motivated to do my best!
